title: nemanthera bufalina
intro: Nemanthera bufalina, commonly known as Wild Buffalo Grass, is a plant species native to certain regions of Asia. This herb is traditionally used in traditional Chinese medicine, known for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Nemanthera bufalina involve reducing fever, relieving pain, and improving immune function. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
